quick-actions-grid.purpose: Group frequent mobile actions into a scannable grid with labels, permission states, confirmation, and feedback.
useWhen: A mobile dashboard or object detail needs frequent shortcuts.
Actions are independent and can be understood by label plus icon.
Permission or risk states must remain visible.
doNotUseWithoutReview: Actions need long explanation, search, or form input.
Disabled or destructive actions lack recovery copy.
foundations: Defines grid columns, tap target size, gap, and responsive wrapping.
Keeps action labels direct and explains unavailable actions.
Controls priority, disabled, danger, focus, and selected states.
Uses icons only as reinforcement; text remains required.
Requires labels, focus order, and non-color-only status.
slots: Short explanation for blocked or ambiguous actions.
Small state count or availability marker.
variants: Common actions for a vehicle or card.
Disabled or blocked action explains why.
Risky shortcut opens confirmation before side effect.
motion: Risky action opens Dialog with Design System overlay motion.
Tooltip appears only on user request or focus.
accessibility: Each quick action has a text label.
Grid order matches visual reading order.
Confirmation is required for risky side effects.
tests: Actions render through Quick Action components.
Risky action opens Dialog after click.

canDecide: Use Quick Actions Grid for frequent independent shortcuts.
Use Tooltip for short blocked-state hints.
Use Dialog for risky action confirmation.
mustAsk: Action priority, permissions, destructive policy, or grid density is unclear.
miel.handoff: Confirm action list, priority, permission states, destructive rules, grid density, and feedback.
